title: SkyControl lost link to monitoring
fullDescription: SkyControl panel communicates via Wi-Fi and cellular. If both fail, no comm is shown.

title: Sensor battery low
shortDescription: A wireless sensor needs battery replacement.
fullDescription: Vivint sensors use CR2 and CR123 lithium batteries, lasting 3-5 years.

title: Sensor tamper triggered
shortDescription: Sensor removed from mount or cover opened.

title: Sensor not communicating
fullDescription: Panel hasn't heard from sensor. Check battery and position.

title: Panel lost wired internet
shortDescription: Ethernet cable disconnected or router down.
fullDescription: Some Vivint panels use wired backhaul.

fixSteps.title: Reseat cable
fixSteps.instruction: Reseat Ethernet at panel and router.

title: Alarm without intrusion
fullDescription: Common causes include pets, drafts, and door/window left open.

fixSteps.title: Cancel alarm
fixSteps.instruction: Enter code; contact Vivint to cancel dispatch.

title: Entry delay expired
fullDescription: Adjust delay in panel settings or app.

title: Panel AC power lost
fullDescription: AC outage or tripped breaker. Backup battery keeps system alive ~24h.

title: Vivint Doorbell Camera Pro offline
fullDescription: Vivint Doorbell Camera Pro needs Wi-Fi and 16-24VAC.
